summary: Capture both nodes' sync state when profile validation times out
details: Collect canonical heads and total difficulty, peer advertised heads and total difficulty, peer counts and sync progress before profile runner cleanup.
Save bounded read-only diagnostics to stderr and incremental JSON artifacts, preserving RPC errors and the original failure when collection fails.
Retain strict final height and head-hash equality, reject empty or invalid expected hashes, and exercise these assertions and timeout paths in Fast CI.
